text:
Leah (PM): quick sync — post-launch backlog triage. main asks: intermittent streaming disconnects (~3% sessions) reported by support, plus a pile of UX polish tickets. what should we prioritize for the next 72h?
Devon (Eng): looking at logs — disconnects align with `kv-cache` eviction spikes during traffic bursts. reproducible in staging. should be fixable without touching model code. estimate: 1 day to patch + canary.
Maya (Design): UX polish (better error copy, retry affordance) will lower ticket volume but is not user-blocking. can scope as next sprint work.
Carlos (CS): two enterprise customers marked this as high-impact and asked for ETA. they'd like a workaround in the meantime.
Leah (PM): proposed plan: run a 3-day micro-sprint to ship a hotpatch (investigate, patch, canary, roll) and defer polish to grooming for the next minor. agree?
Ravi (SRE): agree, but we need explicit rollback criteria and a small canary slice. recommend 5% traffic in us-west for 4 hours, watch disconnect rate and 95th perc latency. rollback if disconnect rate >2x baseline or latency > baseline + 120ms.
Devon (Eng): plan outline: Day 1 repro + implement guard, Day 2 QA + canary, Day 3 monitor + full roll. owner: @Devon.
Maya (Design): I'll draft error copy and retry microflow, deliver PRD by EOW, assign to design owner.
Carlos (CS): I'll provide customers a temporary workaround guide and collect repro steps. will update flagged support threads.
Leah (PM): constraints: no model/quantization changes, no risky infra refactors in this micro-sprint. patch must be revertable.
Devon (Eng): patch sketch:
```
fix(kv): backpressure on eviction
- add `eviction_backpressure` metric
- gate eviction under burst with config flag `eviction_safety`
- add canary toggle
```
Devon (Eng): PR will include unit tests and an integration check for stream ordering.
Leah (PM): QA must include: acceptance tests, token-loss verification, streaming ordering regression, perf baseline comparison. nothing goes to 5% canary without passing these.
Ravi (SRE): I'll add dashboard tiles: eviction_backpressure, stream-disconnect-rate by route, 5xx counts, tail latency. alerts for >1.5x disconnects during canary.
Devon (Eng): tagging @Ravi for infra review on metric scrapers. estimated PR small.
Carlos (CS): when canary passes, I'll draft a customer-facing note + status page update.
Maya (Design): moving polish into backlog: PRD for retry affordance + updated copy. target next sprint.
Leah (PM): final call: hotpatch is top priority. polish moved to "post-hotpatch grooming". milestone: hotpatch either deployed or rolled back within 3 days.
Devon (Eng): assigning labels `owner:devon`, `hotpatch`, creating issue now.
TriBot: Reminder scheduled for canary check at 4h after rollout (1739013650).
Leah (PM): thanks all. if hotpatch surfaces systemic eviction issues we'll open a follow-up infra epic.
Carlos (CS): noted; I'll keep the customers updated.
Ravi (SRE): I'll produce a rollback playbook and add a short runbook entry.
Leah (PM): closing thread — will reconvene after hotpatch completes. :thumbsup:
